scientific_integrity: Proof of the integral automorphism-module formula for the full finite family; the homotopy classification is nonequivariant. Finite code checks corroborate but do not prove the general case. Earlier literature already determines balanced-tree nonequivariant homotopy types. The whole-tree diameter-four shellability guarantee is already covered by Ghosh–Selvaraja (2025).
scientific_limitations: Requires at least two arms and one leaf per arm
No assertion of equivariant homotopy classification
No results on arbitrary tree shapes or r different from 2
Unindexed or unpublished equivalent representations are possible
title: Integral equivariant homology of height-two tree \(2\)-independence complexes
